name: Badge
description: A small indicator attached to another element — showing a count, status, or "new" marker. Draws attention to changes or unread items.
summary: Small indicator (count, status dot) attached to an element

elements.name: Value/content
elements.description: Count number, dot, or text label

elements.name: Position anchor
elements.description: The element the badge is attached to

usageNotes: Use for notification counts, unread indicators, or status dots attached to buttons, icons, or avatars.
For counts over 99, consider truncating to "99+" to keep the badge compact.
Ensure color choices meet accessibility contrast requirements against both the badge background and the page/anchor element.
A dot badge is useful when you want to indicate presence or activity without a specific count.
